column1: Deposit to seller for Option to Purchase (OTP)
column2: You must pay the sellers a deposit ($2 to $5,000), which consists of the Option Fee and Option Exercise Fee, during the granting and exercising of the Option to Purchase respectively.

column1: Processing fee for Request for Value
column2: If you intend to buy a resale flat using your CPF savings and/ or a housing loan, make a Request for Value to HDB to determine the value that will form the basis for your CPF usage and/ or the reference for the housing loan amount from HDB or the financial institution (FI), unless otherwise advised by the FI. You will need to pay a processing fee of $120.
